brief: Money mindset shifts every founder needs. From scarcity to leverage, hustle to compounding, selling time to selling outcomes. The AI-era reframes that change everything.

slots.subtitle: The AI-era reframes that separate scaling founders from stalled ones, starting with value itself.
slots.preview1: How to escape the scarcity trap with leverage
slots.preview2: Why compounding beats hustle every single time
slots.preview3: The shift from selling hours to outcomes

slots.title: Escape scarcity
slots.subtitle: Founders who hoard control starve; those who delegate capital and code multiply output.
slots.insight1Body: Use no-code tools and contractors to test demand before hiring.
slots.insight2Body: Reinvest revenue into systems that reduce your direct labor.
slots.insight3Body: Refusing to spend is often fear dressed as discipline.
slots.pullQuote: The brokest founders I know are the ones doing every task themselves.

slots.title: Compounding beats
slots.subtitle: Linear effort creates paychecks; exponential assets create freedom and optionality.
slots.insight1Body: Turn services into products and content into evergreen lead generation.
slots.insight2Body: An email list compounds in value while ads drain cash.
slots.insight3Body: Every yes to a meeting is a no to deep work.
slots.pullQuote: Hustle is a startup tax; compounding is the only real equity.

slots.title: Sell outcomes
slots.subtitle: Clients do not want your time; they want transformation delivered reliably.
slots.insight1Body: Charge a percentage of revenue gained, not hours logged in dashboards.
slots.insight2Body: Package expertise into fixed-scope offers with clear boundaries and guarantees.
slots.insight3Body: CFOs approve ROI, not timesheets; speak the language they already trust.
slots.pullQuote: The moment I stopped billing hours, my income doubled and churn vanished.

slots.title: AI changes
slots.subtitle: Intelligence is now a variable cost, which rewrites every old hiring assumption.
slots.insight1Body: One operator with AI tools can replace three traditional full-time roles.
slots.insight2Body: Ship in days what competitors budget quarters for; iteration beats planning.
slots.insight3Body: When execution gets cheap, taste and strategy become the scarce assets.
slots.pullQuote: AI did not replace me; it replaced the tasks that were hiding my value.

slots.title: Stack beliefs
slots.subtitle: Mindsets are not abstract; they are operating systems that determine capital allocation.
slots.insight1Body: Keep burn low and experiments high so luck can find you working.
slots.insight2Body: Take distributions early; forced profitability sharpens product decisions faster than VC pressure.
slots.insight3Body: You are not your last launch; attachment kills the pivot that saves you.
slots.pullQuote: I stopped playing founder and started playing probability; the board changed overnight.

slots.title: Start now
slots.subtitle: A single decision made today can rewire how your business generates cash.
slots.insight1Body: Identify three tasks AI or a contractor can own by Friday morning.
slots.insight2Body: Add a premium tier that anchors outcomes, not effort, and test demand.
slots.insight3Body: Write one template or guide that earns leads while you sleep tonight.
slots.pullQuote: The best time to shift your mindset was yesterday; the next best is now.

slots.ctaBody: Mindset is the only unfair advantage that compounds while you sleep.
